Name: Blue Raspberry Crop
Author: CactusWithGlasses
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Bring the nostalgic, sugary taste of blue raspberries (which are totally a real crop and not at all artificial, nope, nu uh) to Stardew Valley.

Seeds can be purchased from Sandy, and they grow in the summer. They will take 10 days to grow, but keep producing afterwards, and produce multiple fruit per harvest! I tried to balance them around the idea of them being a less valuable crop than Starfruit, but to gain some of the advantages of crops like blueberry, however this is my first mod so the balance may not be super good just yet.

Speaking of, this IS my first mod, so basically all the spritework is recolored and mashed together vanilla assets. I'll hopefully improve and replace them with more unique art as time goes on. I also hope to expand into possible cooking recipes and artisan goods exclusive to blue raspberries, but for now enjoy them as a new crop option for your farms!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Install like any other Content Patcher Mod (As long as I've done this right, first mod still! Lets hope I upload correctly!)[/color][/size]

[color=#d4d4d8]-Download and [/color][color=#d4d4d8]install [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][/url][color=#ffffff][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/color][color=#d4d4d8] and [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
-Install my mod's main file, extract it, and copy the '[CP] Blue Raspberry Crop' folder to your 'Mods' folder
-Launch Stardew Valley with SMAPI

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

Optionally, I recommend any mods that allow you to process fruit into new artisan goods, make all the Blue Raspberry treats you can imagine!

Some recommendations that I'm currently using include:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049?tab=files]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24104?tab=files]Pokemon Berry Bushes[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173?tab=files]Artisanal Soda Makers[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url]

And I know the community likely has many many more!

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I'd like to thank the Stardew Valley Modding Wiki for getting me through my first attempt at a Stardew Mod.[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]And I'd like to also thank the greater community, there's a lot of you out there who, just by being creative, inspired me to even give this a try. In particular though, a shout out to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Aldino112]Aldino112 [/url]and their mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21484?tab=description]MBF More Crops Fruits and Forage[/url] that beat me to the punch several years ago, and I only found out their mod already had a growable blue raspberry [b]after[/b] I had made the sprites for my mod. Whoops! Still, wanted to see the idea through, and the two of our mods are compatible from my testing, so feel free to download their expansion as well and add a bunch of new items to your game![/color]
